title: Blinko
descript: Blinko is a self-hosted note-taking app with Markdown, tags, full-text search, AI summaries and a mobile-friendly UI. This package runs the official Docker Hub image with its own PostgreSQL database as non-root containers; notes and attachments stay in the application data folder.
important: Open the web UI to create the first account. The stack contains two containers (app, PostgreSQL) that are only reachable from the app. Data lives under /Volume1/DockerAppData/blinkodocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The app generates its own NEXTAUTH_SECRET on first start. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。

zh-hk.important: 首次使用請開啟網頁完成初始化。資料保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重新啟動和升級不會遺失。容器以 uid 1000 運行，掛載目錄需對該使用者可讀。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可達時先設定鏡像加速。解除安裝並刪除資料前請備份。區域網路內為 HTTP。
